strategy.text: First align the types and codec, then the generic cage and its token policies. Delete the consumer withdrawal requirement together with its script.

For naming, derive the ordinary request-validator identity from the same registry and apply its hash as an immutable application parameter. Then align approval arms, fold-created records and retirement's co-created request. Conformance and documentation follow.
Nothing red may merge to main. Intermediate draft-branch failures are not acceptance.

constraints.text: The revision-bound Lean model and its refusal reasons govern the implementation. Each Aiken refusal trace maps to one model reason, with executable rows and controls. The read uses the existing MPF update verifier; published constructor indices are preserved and new ones appended.

Regenerate script identities and record their hashes without changing the preproduction deployment claim. Derive the identity tuple in order: parameterless cage and seed-derived token, applied request validator, applied naming application, then genesis pins. No redeemer chooses the request hash, and the cage gains no RequestDatum spending arm.

trace-label-table.text: The handback carries the table Aiken trace → Lean reason for every refusal above; the auditor checks it is total over the Lean refusal reasons that the cage can reach, and that no Aiken trace maps to two reasons.

invariant-rows-naming.text: The naming rows cover signature-bound booking approvals, open absent insertion, refund-authorized absent deletion and refused active deletion. They retain the record's single-asset invariant and maintain/recover behavior.

Retirement accepts the recovery key or quorum but never the current key alone, and leaves an active leaf with the actual produced request at the bound validator. Completion consumes that request through Contribute together with state Modify and custody, burns the active token and writes terminal.

Wrong validator, wrong registry token, missing approval and mismatched approval each refuse beside the connected positive story. A manually seeded completion request is not evidence. Folded booking and read destinations receive the request value minus its tip; terminal permits reads but no tree-changing edge.
